title: Fairy Tales
blurb: Classic tales, the people who wrote them down, and magic objects.

hr.title: Bajke
hr.blurb: Klasične bajke, ljudi koji su ih zapisali i čarobni predmeti.

questions.q: In what year did the Brothers Grimm publish their first book of tales?
questions.fact: The first volume of Children's and Household Tales came out on December 20, 1812.

hr.q: Koje su godine braća Grimm objavila svoju prvu knjigu bajki?
hr.fact: Prvi svezak njihovih Dječjih i obiteljskih bajki izašao je 20. prosinca 1812.

questions.q: About how many tales were in the Grimms' very first volume?
questions.fact: The first volume had 86 tales. By the last edition in 1857, the collection had grown to 200 tales.

hr.q: Otprilike koliko je bajki bilo u prvom svesku braće Grimm?
hr.fact: Prvi svezak imao je 86 bajki. Do posljednjeg izdanja 1857. zbirka je narasla na 200 bajki.

questions.fact: Andersen was a Danish writer who also wrote The Emperor's New Clothes.

hr.q: Tko je napisao bajku Ružno pače?
hr.fact: Andersen je bio danski pisac koji je napisao i bajku Carevo novo ruho.

questions.q: Which writer gave Cinderella a glass slipper in 1697?
questions.fact: The glass slipper is special to Perrault's French version. Other versions use different shoes.

hr.q: Koji je pisac 1697. Pepeljugi dao staklenu cipelicu?
hr.fact: Staklena cipelica posebnost je Perraultove francuske inačice. U drugim inačicama cipele su drugačije.

questions.q: True or false: The Brothers Grimm came from Germany.
questions.fact: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm were also language experts who started a giant German dictionary.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: braća Grimm bila su iz Njemačke.
hr.fact: Jacob i Wilhelm Grimm bili su i stručnjaci za jezik koji su započeli golemi rječnik njemačkog jezika.

questions.q: The Little Mermaid statue sits in which city?
questions.fact: The statue honors Andersen's tale and was unveiled on August 23, 1913.

hr.q: U kojem se gradu nalazi kip Male sirene?
hr.fact: Kip je posvećen Andersenovoj bajci i otkriven je 23. kolovoza 1913.

questions.q: In Rumpelstiltskin, straw is spun into what?
questions.fact: The tale was written down by the Brothers Grimm, and the miller's daughter wins by guessing a name.

hr.q: U bajci Cvilidreta (Rumpelstiltskin) slama se prede u što?
hr.fact: Bajku su zapisala braća Grimm, a mlinareva kći pobjeđuje tako što pogodi ime.

questions.q: In Hansel and Gretel, the witch's house is made of what?
questions.fact: In the Grimms' telling the walls are bread, the roof is cake and the windows are clear sugar. Many later retellings made it gingerbread.

hr.q: Od čega je vještičja kućica u bajci Ivica i Marica?
hr.fact: Kod braće Grimm zidovi su od kruha, krov od kolača, a prozori od prozirnog šećera. Mnoge kasnije priče pretvorile su je u kućicu od medenjaka.

questions.q: In The Emperor's New Clothes, who says the emperor has nothing on?
questions.fact: Andersen's tale is famous for showing that sometimes a child is brave enough to say what everyone sees.

hr.q: Tko u bajci Carevo novo ruho kaže da je car gol?
hr.fact: Andersenova bajka poznata je po tome što pokazuje da je ponekad baš dijete dovoljno hrabro reći ono što svi vide.

questions.q: In Russian folk tales, Baba Yaga's hut stands on what?
questions.fact: In many tales, Baba Yaga's hut can turn around to face visitors, and she rides in a giant mortar.

hr.q: Na čemu u ruskim bajkama stoji kućica Babe Jage?
hr.fact: U mnogim pričama kućica Babe Jage može se okrenuti prema posjetiteljima, a Baba Jaga leti u golemoj stupi.
